title: Furg Citadel
scope: The standing and ruined exterior of Furg Citadel on the ridge above Forg village, with the irregular outer curtain, round towers, west high compound and eastern entry.
limitations: The model represents the hilltop structure’s present exterior character. Internal rooms, underground features and exact individual interior ruins have no verified geometric record here.
Overall plan and terrain follow the native map and elevation. Tower positions between vertices, wall heights, unseen exterior detail and repair phases use conservative estimates.
